description: Search the chosen sources, then answer with a FLOP or OpenRouter model, citing results as [n]. Returns sources[] (n, title, url, snippet; kept even when inference fails), source_report[] (count, error, time_s per source), pricing (Scout's fee), answers[] (answer or error, model, receipt, inference_estimate) and quota. If no source returns results, no inference runs and answers[] is empty. A URL in q is read by the page source, which auto adds; for one page's text without a model use scout_read. Inference uses keys.flop or keys.openrouter when given, else Scout's own FLOP key, which can be unavailable. Each call counts against the rate limit unless no answer is produced; the same request from the same caller within 10 minutes returns the cached answer free.

keys.description: Caller keys by name: flop, openrouter, or a source key named in scout_catalog sources[].key. Used for this request only; never stored or logged.

sources.description: Source ids from scout_catalog, or ["auto"] to let Scout pick up to 3 free sources from the question. Unknown ids are ignored. Default: keenable.

name: scout_answer
title: Search sources and answer with citations
